risk_summary: A SCIM disable event marks the user inactive but leaves app-local admin roles, API tokens, and cached sessions active after termination.

missing_controls: role and group revocation on disable

expected_findings.reason: The mapper matches lifecycle events by mutable email instead of a tenant-scoped immutable identifier.
Deprovisioning disables login but leaves admin roles, billing access, API tokens, and cached sessions active.
No reconciliation evidence detects drift between the source termination event and app-local entitlements.
